name: o39754

schema.title: JSON schema for Azure Functions extensions.json files

hintPath.description: An optional file path hint to the assembly containing the type.

description: The Azure Functions project currently includes three extensions. The **BlobStorage** extension is registered under the type name `Microsoft.Azure.WebJobs.Extensions.Storage.BlobExtension, Microsoft.Azure.WebJobs.Extensions.Storage` and its assembly can be found at `bin\extensions\Microsoft.Azure.WebJobs.Extensions.Storage.dll`. The **EventGrid** extension uses the type name `Microsoft.Azure.WebJobs.Extensions.EventGrid.EventGridExtension, Microsoft.Azure.WebJobs.Extensions.EventGrid` with its binary located at `bin\extensions\Microsoft.Azure.WebJobs.Extensions.EventGrid.dll`. Finally, the **CosmosDB** extension is present with the type name `Microsoft.Azure.WebJobs.Extensions.CosmosDB.CosmosDBExtension, Microsoft.Azure.WebJobs.Extensions.CosmosDB`; this extension does not require an explicit hint path because it is resolved implicitly.
